name: go-tc-presence-aware-qdisc-option-state
instr:
go-tc cannot inspect how typed qdisc options appeared on the wire or emit them canonically or in occurrence order without opaque byte replay. Add this support without changing behavior when option state is unused.

`OptionState` must return an immutable occurrence snapshot. Deterministic field names, offsets, encoded lengths, and repetition indexes must describe every represented wire field truthfully. `QdiscEmitPolicy` is `uint8`; `EmitCanonical` is 0 and the default, and `EmitPreserveOccurrences` is 1. Keep policy selection isolated per `Tc`.

FqCodel and FqPie must preserve repeated scalar occurrences in encounter order while current typed values remain authoritative. FqPie includes EcnProb, Bytemode, and DqRateEstimator. Red must preserve the independent ordering of its atomic RedQOpt payload, scalar attributes, and 64-bit attributes. Sfb and Sfq expose fixed representations only as indivisible occurrences.

Invalid policies, occurrence boundaries, or subdivisions of Sfb and Sfq must fail deterministically without partial output. Before emitting bytes or sending a connection, return `QdiscOptionError` with the relevant kind, field, offset, and underlying error.

Add, Replace, Link, Change, and Delete must honor the selected policy without changing established validation, operation types, flags, or errors. Get and monitoring must produce equivalent typed values and state from identical option bytes. Keep state-free encoding, round trips, and short-message behavior unchange
